tools.name: search_signals

tools.name: get_source_health
tools.description: Inspect automated source coverage, last runs, failures, and content freshness.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_signals" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.

evidence.snippet: before: "Search niubiagent signals by keyword, category, tag, and sort order. Returns source-backed, machine-readable results." → after: "Search and page through the full niubiagent archive by keyword, category, tag, and sort order. Returns source-backed results and pageCount."

findings.remediation: Re-review the tool before continuing to trust it.
